competitors.name: Bettani Farms
competitors.action: Announced an April 8 pivot to mozzarella and B2B CPG sales, explicitly targeting frozen pizza and frozen appetizer manufacturers with its casein-mimicking 'Caseed' protein. Company says self-affirmed GRAS is nearly complete, commercial scale-up trials succeeded, and launches are expected within the next few months.
competitors.notes: High-signal ingredient play for frozen pizza. Not a direct shelf competitor yet, but it points to continued investment in pizza-specific cheese functionality and gives larger CPG brands another way to launch premium plant-forward or mixed-dairy SKUs fast.

competitors.name: Mama Cozzi's / Aldi
competitors.action: Rolled out new Neapolitan Style Bianca and Supreme frozen pizzas starting April 8 at $5.49, plus a Bruschetta pizza at $5.29 in Aldi's weekly rotation.
competitors.notes: Important because value retail is now merchandising Neapolitan-style cues at aggressive price points. That keeps premium crust language moving mainstream and makes crust/story differentiation even more important for Real Dough.

competitors.name: Di Fara Frozen
competitors.action: National Target expansion is now live, following the brand's frozen line extension to four SKUs including Vodka Sauce and Three Meat.
competitors.notes: Another restaurant-to-retail pizza brand scaling into big-box distribution. Confirms Target is willing to carry premium/heritage frozen pizza brands, not just mass-market incumbents.

trends.topic: Frozen, uncooked pizza emerging as a natural-channel leader
trends.magnitude: Expo West 2026 identified frozen, uncooked pizza as a category leader over traditional reheated frozen pizza
trends.context: Natural Products Expo West reported pizza had an unusually large presence this year, with dairy-forward formulations and frozen uncooked products gaining momentum. That is a strong signal that 'closer to fresh' frozen pizza is becoming a real retail story, especially in natural/specialty channels where Real Dough fits best.

breaking.headline: Aldi pushes Neapolitan-style frozen pizza under $6
breaking.impact: Premium crust cues are no longer premium-only. Expect more shoppers to understand Neapolitan/sourdough language, but also more price pressure from value players.
